A '''Spell of Discover''' was a [[Dathomir Magic|spell]] that could be cast by the [[Witches of Dathomir]]. It allowed a witch to detect all [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings within ten [[Meter/Legends|meters]] of her.<ref name="CTD" />
